opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to individuals from low‑income households who are ordinarily resident in Scotland, have completed at least two years of secondary or college education in Scotland (or have a substantial connection), are entitled to remain in the UK, and are not eligible for other public tuition fee funding. Applies to undergraduate degree courses at eligible Scottish institutions.
opportunities.summary: Provides grants of up to £1,820 per year to cover tuition fees for eligible undergraduate students in the 2026‑27 academic year.
